lines.meet: Qué más, parce, I'm Santiago, a runemaster. Every rune's a line you can't take back, same as a tattoo, just louder.
lines.meet_neighbour: The Ashen Reach, parce! I've seen you near the works. I'm Santiago, the one cutting runes into everything.
lines.ask_home: Which city made you, parce? Tell me, I like a good origin story.
lines.ask_work: Before all this, parce, what paid the bills? You've got the hands of somebody who made things.
lines.answer_home: Medellín, parce, born and raised. My mother sold arepas from a cart, and I drew on everything, and then on people.
lines.answer_work: Tattoo artist, nine years, in a shop in Laureles with my cousin. The waiting list ran for months.
lines.chat_food: Bandeja paisa, parce, the whole plate, beans and rice and chicharrón and an egg on top. You need a nap after.
lines.chat_sleep: After a good day's line work I'm out like a light. A bad line keeps me up all night.
lines.chat_missing: Reggaeton in the shop, loud, and a first-timer in the chair, nervous, leaving brave. That's the best feeling.
lines.chat_here: The first rune I cut glowed, parce, and I spent a week working out what I'd done right. Then I couldn't stop.
lines.tease_quiet: You'd be a perfect client, {name}, you'd sit still for six hours and never complain.
lines.tease_talker: You'd talk through the whole session, {name}, and I'd let you. It keeps the nerves away.
lines.tease_careful: You'd choose a design for a year before you let me near you, {name}. Bacano, that's how you get a good one.
lines.tease_bold: You'd let me tattoo your face on the first meeting, {name}. I'd say no, and I'd be tempted.
lines.tease_any: You're a work in progress, {name}, the way a good sleeve is. I like where it's going.
lines.tease_back: Ha, bacano, {name}! Clean line, that one.
lines.take_it_kindly: That's fair, parce, I'll take it. My mother says the same.
lines.bristle: Careful, parce, that's a line you can't take back.
lines.apologise: Ay, perdón, parce, that was ugly of me. I'm sorry, really.
lines.double_down: No, parce, I'm keeping it. Some lines you commit to.
lines.needle_quiet: How does it feel, parce? I can't fix the line if you won't tell me.
lines.needle_talker: Please, parce, quiet for a second. I need a steady hand.
lines.needle_careful: You've stared at it so long, parce. Commit to the line.
lines.needle_bold: Rushed lines are ugly, parce, and you rush every single one. I can't stand ugly lines.
lines.needle_any: Your work is sloppy, parce, and sloppy lines get people hurt here.
lines.bite_back: I've done three hundred clients' worth of designs without a bad line. Don't talk to me about care.
lines.hurt: Ay, that went in deep, parce. I'll go and draw for a while.
lines.laugh_off: Ha, my mother said worse about my tattoos every Sunday, parce, so come on.
lines.confide: {name}, I was putting my little brother through a good school in Bogotá. I never once told him how proud I was of him.
lines.listen: I'm here, parce. Talk me through it, like a first-timer.
lines.look_out: Stay out of the sparks in there, {name}. When I cut, things get loud.
lines.deflect: It's nothing, parce, a little scratch. My own needle's done worse to me.
lines.check_in: Talk me through it, {name}, slowly. Which part's hurting?
lines.blame: Somebody rushed the line in there, parce, and now it's ruined.
lines.thank: Parce, I was out and now I'm not! Free tattoo, any design, whenever you want.
lines.brush_off: Pues, it's nothing, parce. Breathe, you're brave.
lines.worry: Ay, parce, {name}, that scared me. Breathe slowly, like a first-timer.
lines.handed_down: So this gear of yours is mine for now, parce. I'll treat it like my best machine.
lines.hand_fine: Take it, parce, it looks bacano on you. I've got my grip.
lines.hand_sulk: Nobody even checked with me, parce. That's not cool.
lines.turn_friendly: You're my client for life now, {name}, parce. Front of the waiting list.
lines.turn_friends: Nobody else touches my rune notebook, {name}, but you can design one with me.
lines.turn_grating: This isn't working between us, parce. That's okay, not every design works.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll still cut your runes, because I'm a professional. Don't ask for a tattoo.
lines.make_up: Enough, {name}, parce. Let's start the design again.
lines.defend: Oye, cut it out, parce, that's not fair. Leave {name} alone.
lines.friend_left: The shop feels empty with {name} away, parce, nobody to show my sketches.
lines.friend_back: Qué más, {name}, you're back! I've got a new design to show you.
lines.common_craft: Nine years of line work, and every line's one you can't take back. Anybody who makes things by hand knows the patience is the craft.
lines.common_spanish: Somebody here speaks Spanish, parce! Qué más, finally I can talk properly.
